title: ask_user arguments
description: Arguments of the client-side `ask_user` tool. Ask 1-3 clarifying questions, each with 1-4 suggested answers; the UI always offers a free-text answer too. Call it at most once per turn and only when the answer is needed to continue. Declared by the SPA in RunAgentInput.tools; validated by the SPA and by the agent-service.

id.description: Stable identifier of the question, unique within this call (for example "q1"). Answers refer to it.

header.description: Very short label (at most 24 characters) shown as the stepper tab, for example "Target users".

question.description: The full question, phrased for a product owner.

rationale.description: Optional one-sentence reason why the answer matters for the backlog item.

relatedSection.description: Optional document section heading the answer will affect.

label.description: Short answer the user can pick.

options.description: 1-4 suggested answers. The UI always adds a free-text 'Other' answer itself; do not add one.

recommended.description: Optional zero-based index (0-3) into options of the answer you recommend; the UI shows it first with a badge. Should be smaller than the number of options (consumers ignore an out-of-range index).

multiSelect.description: Allow selecting several options (checkboxes). Defaults to false.

questions.description: 1-3 questions, shown one at a time.
